导入数据
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
gender_inequality <- read_excel(
  here("data", "wk4", "hdr-data.xlsx")
)
view(gender_inequality)
```
导入geojson
```{r}
library(sf)
world <- st_read(here("data","wk4","World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
)
world
```
挑选需要的列 将原来的长表转换为宽表方便计算差值
```{r}
rawdata <- gender_inequality%>%select(.,countryIsoCode,country,indexCode,year,value)
data <- rawdata%>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value
  )
view(data)
```
计算差值
```{r}
class(data$`2019`)
class(data$`2010`)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    `2019` = as.numeric(`2019`),
    `2010` = as.numeric(`2010`),
    difference = `2019` - `2010`
  )
view(data)
```
```{r}
library(countrycode)
world <- world %>% mutate(
    ISO = countrycode(
      COUNTRY,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    )
  )
final_data <- left_join(world,data, by = c("ISO"="countryIsoCode"))
view(final_data)
```
